blocks.raw: You should insert a header in your api calls with the version of the Modulr api. This allows us to manage our clients' compatibility if we introduce any breaking changes in the api (which is rare).
blocks.text: You should insert a header in your api calls with the version of the Modulr api. This allows us to manage our clients' compatibility if we introduce any breaking changes in the api (which is rare).

blocks.raw: To do this insert a header `x-mod-version` with a single integer version number as the value
blocks.text: To do this insert a header x-mod-version with a single integer version number as the value

blocks.raw: Only the major version number should be sent (so send 1 rather than 1.0.1)
